body:
marco: Hey @frontdesk — FYI a vendor (Maya / Acme) said she'd arrive ~12:15 with a large poster + a package. Can someone confirm badges for external vendors? Also might need an extra folding chair in the south lounge. cc @leah
frontdesk-bot: New delivery logged: DHL for Marco Rivera — 1x 'large poster' / package tag #DHL-87321. Placed in Receiving Locker B.
frontdesk: They're checked in on the kiosk under "Marco Rivera" (guest name Maya / Acme). Badge printed and gave directions. We'll bring the poster to South Lounge and leave a folding chair by the couch.
leah: Quick note — vendors who go into meeting rooms need signed NDA. If it's just drop-off/pick-up that's fine. Marco, do you want us to mark the package "fragile"?
jin: Heads up — I have a quick sync at 12:30 in South Lounge. If you need the space ping me and I can move the call.
priya: Can we ask them to use the side loading entrance? Big posters jam the main door last time :sweat_smile:
frontdesk: Yes — asked them to pull up to loading bay and use side entrance. We'll add a "fragile" sticker and use the dolly.
marco: Awesome, thanks. One more thing: guest might ask for a quick private chair / space — is lactation/quiet room available? @leah
leah: Lactation room is reserved for staff only. We can book Conf Room E for a 30-min private drop-off if needed. Want me to hold it?
ava: FYI label says "handle with magnets" somehow lol, i'll swing by to help carry the poster so it doesn't catch on doors.
marco: Please do, thanks @ava. frontdesk, LMK when you want me downstairs to meet them (or i can send them straight to loading).
frontdesk: No need to come down, we'll wheel it up in ~10 mins. leaving chair in south lounge now. :thumbsup:
leah: Thanks everyone. I'll send a quick vendor checklist reminder to ops so this is smoother next time. :sparkles:
